title: Time-to-read as a first-class filter and sort
acceptance: The library can be filtered to articles that fit a span of time — under 5, under 10, under 20 minutes
Reading time is shown on every row and card
The estimate derives from the existing word count, with the assumed words-per-minute stated in code
Filtering by time composes with the existing filters rather than replacing them
notes: Owner saves a lot and reads little. A pile of 300 is paralysing; 'what fits in the seven minutes I have' is a menu. wordCount already exists on Post, so this is close to free and has the best value-to-effort ratio on the list.

history.detail: was Cairn/Views/** which monopolised the whole view layer; narrowed to the four files a reading-time filter actually needs
